question: For the Cu2O-Ag loofah monolith, what is the mean decolorization efficiency of the Box-Behnken center-point runs (pH 6.0, 70 mg/L, 0.70 g)?
rendered:
According to Table 2, the mean decolorization efficiency of the Box-Behnken center-point runs (pH 6.0, 70 mg/L, 0.70 g) is:

(96.04 + 96.79 + 98.98) / 3 = 97.27%
